Agent.description: A voice agent and its current draft.

archivedAt.description: When the agent was archived; `null` while it is active.

draftHash.description: SHA-256 of the draft: what a test run tested and what a version froze.

purpose.description: The purpose version it pins; its compliance class is `useCase`.

AgentList.description: Active agents, most recently updated first (at most 200).

AgentPlan.description: An agent's plan: the saved one, or its use case's template until one is saved.

lockedTexts.description:
What the start step must open with, word for word and in order. Empty when no rule
pack covers the agent yet.

optOutConfirmation.description:
What the agent says, word for word, when the caller opts out, before the call ends.
`null` when no rule pack covers the agent yet.

rulePack.description: The rule pack the plan is checked against.

saved.description: `false` while this is the template: nothing is stored until a plan is saved.

AgentPurpose.description: The purpose version an agent pins, and the update to a newer one.

oneOf.description: `null` when the agent pins the latest version.

AgentScenarios.description:
The agent's test scenarios: the saved ones, or its use case's defaults with
`saved: false`.

saved.description: `false` while these are the use case's defaults.

AgentSummary.description: An agent as lists show it.

AgentTestRuns.description: An agent's test runs, newest first (at most 20), with its current draft hash.

BuiltinToolInfo.description: A built-in tool, as pickers show it.

locked.description: Always on: a purpose can't turn it off.

ComplianceAdditions.description: What a purpose adds to its rule pack. Tighten-only: there is no audit period to shorten.

recordingsDays.description: Keep recordings at most this many days; `null` keeps the pack's period.

transcriptsDays.description: Keep transcripts at most this many days; `null` keeps the pack's period.

ComplianceAdditionsInput.description: Compliance additions: tighten-only. There is no field for the audit period.

ComplianceBaseline.description:
A shipped jurisdiction's rule pack for the purpose's class: its baseline, read-only, and
the effective policy with the purpose's additions.

CreateAgentRequest.description:
Create an agent. Only `name`, `useCase` and `voice` are required; every other field has
a default the server fills in.

jurisdiction.description: Region code, e.g. `US`, `US-CA` or `UK`. Picks the rule-pack variant.

purposeId.description:
Pin this purpose's latest version (from `GET /api/v1/purposes`); `useCase` must then be
its compliance class. `null` pins the use case's built-in purpose.

useCase.description: What the agent is for (any case is accepted).

CreatePurposeInput.description: Make a purpose of the workspace's as a copy of another one.

duplicateOf.description: The purpose to copy: built-in or the workspace's.

version.description: The version to copy; by default the latest (the draft when there is none).

EffectiveCompliance.description: The policy that applies with the purpose's additions.

EscalationRule.description: When to escalate, and what to do then.

message.description: What the agent says, word for word, before it ends the call; `null` for other actions.

when.description: A yes/no question for the decision engine.

EscalationRuleInput.description: When to escalate, and what to do then.

message.description: For `end_call`: what to say before ending, 1-500 characters.

ExpectedAnswer.description: The answer a rubric question expects.

FieldError.description: An invalid request field and how to fix it.

field.description: The field's path in the request body, e.g. `useCase` or `nodes[2].label`.

message.description: What to change, e.g. `Enter a name.`

Guardrails.description: The scope, the never-rules, escalations and limits.

GuardrailsInput.description: Guardrails; a list left out is empty, the call length 30 minutes.

status.description: Always `ok` while the process serves HTTP: a process that can't serve doesn't answer.

version.description: The server's version (the `vak-api` package version), e.g. `0.1.0`.

HttpMethod.description: The HTTP method a tool calls with.

HttpTool.description: A custom HTTP tool. The secret is a name in the workspace's secret store, never a value.

confirm.description: Whether the agent confirms with the caller before calling it.

secret.description: The secret's name, e.g. `CALENDAR_API_KEY`; `null` when the API needs none.

HttpToolInput.description:
A custom HTTP tool. `secret` names a secret in the workspace's secret store; the API has
no field for a secret's value.

description.description: What the tool does, 1-500 characters: the LLM reads it.

name.description: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits or `_`, starting with a letter.

url.description: `https://`, with a host on the tool host allow-list.

Language.description: A language the agent can speak and understand.

code.description: The language code to send as `language`.

LatencyBucket.description: Replies whose stage took at most `leMs` (and more than the previous bucket's bound).

leMs.description: The bucket's upper bound in milliseconds; `null` for the slowest bucket.

LockedText.description: Text the agent says word for word, from the rule pack.

ModelProfile.description:
Which LLM profile answers: `balanced` (the main voice model) or `fast` (quicker first
words, simpler answers).

PersonalData.description: Personal data the agent must never ask for.

PlanInput.description: A whole plan: every step and every path. It replaces the saved plan.

edges.description: The paths, in order: at most 200.

nodes.description: The steps, in order: at most 50.

PlanOnUpdate.description:
What an update does to the agent's plan: it `follows` the purpose (no saved plan), is
`replaced` by the new flow (unedited, or edited and replaced on request), or is `kept`.

PlanPathInput.description: A path between two steps, taken when its condition holds.

condition.description: When to take the path, in plain words, up to 200 characters.

from.description: The ID of the step the path leaves.

id.description: Unique within the plan: 1 to 64 letters, digits, `-` or `_`.

to.description: The ID of the step the path leads to.

PlanProblem.description:
The rule a plan breaks, in words, located on a step (`nodeId`), a path (`edgeId`), or
neither (the whole plan).

message.description: What is wrong and how to fix it.

id.description: Unique within the plan: 1 to 64 letters, digits, `-` or `_`.

label.description: The step's name on the canvas, 1 to 80 characters.

text.description: What the agent says or does here, up to 2,000 characters.

PlanValidation.description: Whether the plan follows every rule, and every rule it breaks.

Problem.description:
An RFC 9457 problem. `type` is always `about:blank`, so `title` is the HTTP status phrase;
`detail` says what went wrong and how to fix it.

errors.description: One entry per invalid field (validation errors only).

title.description: The HTTP status phrase, e.g. `Unprocessable Content`.

Purpose.description: A purpose: built-in, or one of the workspace's, with its draft.

latestVersion.description: The latest saved version; `null` before the first.

problems.description: What keeps the draft from being saved as a version.

unsavedChanges.description: Whether the draft differs from the latest version.

usedBy.description: Active agents that pin a version of it.

PurposeChange.description: One thing that changes, in words.

PurposeChangeArea.description: An area of a purpose that changes on update.

PurposeDraft.description: A purpose's draft (or version), without its starting flow (`…/flow`).

PurposeList.description: The built-in purposes in use-case order, then the workspace's own, newest first.

PurposeProblem.description:
Something that keeps the draft from being saved as a version, located by `field` (and
the step or path for the flow).

PurposeRef.description: The purpose version an agent pins.

PurposeSummary.description: A purpose as lists show it.

PurposeTools.description: The tools a purpose turns on.

PurposeToolsInput.description: The tools: built-in ones to turn on (`mark_do_not_call` always is) and HTTP tools.

PurposeUpdate.description:
Moving to the purpose's latest version: what changes, and what happens to the plan unless
the operator asks to replace an edited one.

planEdited.description: The saved plan has the operator's own edits.

Retention.description: How long call data is kept, in days.

RubricCheck.description: A rubric question and the decision model's answer.

passed.description: Whether the answer is on the expected side of 0.5 (which counts as yes).

probability.description: The probability of yes, 0 to 1; `null` when the decision model gave no answer.

RubricItem.description:
A yes/no question the decision model answers about the conversation, and the answer that
passes.

RulePack.description: The compliance rule pack the agent pins: `<jurisdiction>-<use case>` and its version.

Scenario.description: A test scenario: what a simulated caller plays, and how its conversation is scored.

goal.description: What the simulated caller wants, and what to say or not say.

maxTurns.description: The most caller turns before the conversation stops.

persona.description: Who the simulated caller is and how they talk; may be empty.

required.description: A run passes only if every required scenario passes.

id.description:
Unique within the set: 1 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a
letter.

ScenarioOptOutLayer.description: Which opt-out layer ended the conversation.

ScenarioResult.description: One scenario of a run: its definition as tested, and how it went.

durationMs.description: How long it took to play and score.

version.description: The scenario's version: a hash of everything that defines it.

ScenarioStatus.description: Where one scenario of a run is.

ScenariosInput.description: Every scenario of the agent; it replaces the saved set.

scenarios.description: 1 to 8 scenarios with unique IDs, at least one of them required.

SetupProgress.description: Setup progress: four steps, 25 % each, derived from the agent's state.

oneOf.description: The first step not done yet; `null` when setup is complete.

steps.description: Provision, Plan, Test and Publish, in order.

SetupStep.description: A step of the setup flow.

SetupStepStatus.description: One setup step and whether it is done.

count.description: Replies measured since the server started.

p50Ms.description: Median over the last 1000 replies; `null` before the first.

p95Ms.description: 95th percentile over the last 1000 replies; `null` before the first.

StartTestRunInput.description: Start a test run of an agent.

agentId.description: The agent to test, with its current draft and scenarios.

StepKind.description: What a step does: `start` opens the call (the locked texts first), `end` ends it.

TestRun.description: A test run: a job that plays the agent's scenarios against simulated callers.

draftHash.description: The draft the run tests: the agent's when queued, then the one it started on.

finishedAt.description: When it finished, was cancelled or was interrupted.

scenarios.description: Every scenario, in the set's order.

TestRunModels.description: The models a run used, and the seed of its greedy sampling (temperature 0).

decisions.description: The decision model that answered the opt-out questions and scored the rubrics.

llm.description: The LLM that played the agent and the callers.

TestRunProgress.description: How many of a run's scenarios are done.

TestRunStatus.description: Where a run is in its life.

TestRunSummary.description: A run as an agent's list shows it.

current.description: Whether the run tested the agent's current draft; `false` means it is stale.

ToolCatalog.description: What purposes can use: the built-in tools and the hosts HTTP tools may call.

allowedHosts.description:
Exact host names, or `*.example.com` for subdomains. Set by the deployment
(`VAK_TOOL_HOSTS`), not by operators.

ToolInputType.description: The JSON type of a tool input.

ToolInputs.description: A tool's inputs, as a small JSON Schema: an object of typed properties, listed by name.

required.description: The properties the call must carry.

ToolInputsInput.description: A tool's inputs as a small JSON Schema: `type: object`, typed properties, `required`.

properties.description: At most 10, each named like a tool.

ToolInputsType.description: Always `object`: a tool's inputs are the properties of one JSON object.

TranscriptLine.description: One line of a scenario's conversation.

TranscriptSpeaker.description: Who spoke a line: the simulated caller or the agent.

TurnDetection.description: When the caller has finished speaking, and whether they may interrupt the agent.

bargeIn.description: Whether the caller can interrupt the agent while it speaks.

silenceMs.description: Milliseconds of caller silence that end a turn, 200 to 2000.

UpdateAgentPurposeInput.description: Move the agent to another version of its purpose.

replacePlan.description: Replace a plan with the operator's own edits by the new starting flow.

version.description: The version to move to, as `GET …/purpose` offered it.

UpdateAgentRequest.description: Change the agent's draft (autosave). Send only the fields that changed.

purposeId.description:
Switch to this purpose's latest version; a saved plan stays. `useCase` alone switches
to the use case's built-in purpose.

UpdatePurposeInput.description:
Change the draft (autosave). Send only the sections that changed; each replaces that
section whole.

persona.description: The default persona prompt, up to 2,000 characters.

UseCase.description: What the agent is for. It picks the starting template and the default rule pack.

Verdict.description: A finished run's verdict: passed only if every required scenario passed.

Voice.description: A voice the agent can speak with.

id.description: The voice ID to send as `voice`.

VoiceSession.description: A prepared test call: open its media WebSocket within a minute.

mediaUrl.description:
The media WebSocket, relative to the server: subprotocol `vak.media.v1`, usable once,
by the operator who started the session.

VoiceStage.description: A stage of the voice path.

databricksApps.description: Set by the Databricks Apps proxy after sign-on, together with X-Forwarded-User. Clients never send them themselves.
databricksApps.name: X-Forwarded-Email

info.description: Provision, plan, test and publish real-time voice agents. Every `/api/v1` route needs the operator identity Databricks Apps forwards; errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.
info.title: Voice Agent Kitchen API

200.description: Active agents, newest first (at most 200)

get.summary: List active agents, most recently updated first, with their setup progress.

201.description: The agent, with every default filled in

post.summary: Create an agent with only a name, a purpose and a voice; every other field gets a default.

409.description: The agent kept changing while archiving

delete.summary: Archive the agent: lists hide it and its draft can't change. Archiving twice is fine.

200.description: The agent

get.summary: Get one agent, archived or not.

200.description: The agent after the change

409.description: The agent is archived, or kept changing while saving

patch.summary:
Change the agent's draft (autosave). Send only the fields that changed; a change that
changes nothing is stored nowhere and audited nowhere.

200.description: The plan, checked against the agent's rule pack

get.summary:
The agent's plan: the saved one, or its use case's template until one is saved, with the
rule pack it is checked against and its problems.

200.description: The saved plan and its problems

409.description: The agent is archived, or kept changing while saving

422.description: Malformed steps or paths, each named in `errors`

put.summary:
Replace the agent's plan (autosave). A plan that breaks a graph rule is saved too and
answers with its problems; a malformed one is refused and nothing is stored.

200.description: Whether the plan is valid, and its problems

422.description: Malformed steps or paths, each named in `errors`

post.summary: Check a plan against the agent's rule pack without saving it.

200.description: Setup progress, derived from the agent's state

get.summary: The agent's setup progress: Provision, Plan, Test and Publish, 25 % each.

200.description: The pinned purpose version, and the update if a newer one exists

get.summary: The purpose version the agent pins, and the update to a newer one with what it changes.

200.description: The purpose version the agent pins now

409.description: The agent is archived, or kept changing while saving

422.description: No such version, or the one the agent pins

post.summary:
Move the agent to another version of its purpose. A plan with the operator's own edits is
kept unless `replacePlan` is set.

200.description: The scenarios the agent is tested with

get.summary:
The agent's test scenarios: the saved ones, or its use case's defaults until some are
saved.

200.description: The saved scenarios

409.description: The agent is archived, or kept changing while saving

422.description: Malformed scenarios, each field named in `errors`

put.summary: Replace the agent's test scenarios. A malformed set is refused and nothing is stored.

201.description: The session, waiting for its media WebSocket

503.description: Voice isn't set up, too many calls are running, or storage is unavailable

post.summary: Prepare a live test call with the agent.

200.description: The agent's runs

503.description: Test runs aren't set up, or storage is unavailable

get.summary:
The agent's test runs, newest first, each marked `current` when it tested the agent's
current draft.

200.description: Every language, the default first

get.summary: List the languages an agent can speak.

200.description: Built-in tools and the tool host allow-list

get.summary: The built-in tools purposes can turn on, and the hosts their HTTP tools may call.

200.description: Every voice, recommended first

get.summary: List the voices an agent can use.

200.description: Built-in purposes in use-case order, then the workspace's own, newest first

get.summary: List the built-in purposes, then the workspace's own, with their versions and usage.

post.summary: Make a purpose of the workspace's as a copy of another one: a draft without a version.

200.description: The purpose

get.summary: One purpose: its draft without the flow, its problems and its compliance baselines.

200.description: The purpose after the change, with its problems

409.description: A built-in purpose can't change, or it kept changing while saving

422.description: Invalid fields, each named by its path in `errors`

patch.summary:
Change the draft (autosave). Send only the sections that changed; each replaces that
section whole. A change that changes nothing is stored and audited nowhere.

200.description: The starting flow and its problems

get.summary:
The starting flow, in the agent plan's shape, beside its class's locked texts in the
default jurisdiction. It is checked by the graph rules; agents add the locked texts.

200.description: The saved flow and its problems

409.description: A built-in purpose can't change, or it kept changing while saving

422.description: Malformed steps or paths, each named in `errors`

put.summary:
Replace the draft's starting flow (autosave). A flow that breaks a graph rule is saved too
and answers with its problems; a malformed one is refused and nothing is stored.

201.description: The purpose with its new latest version

409.description: A built-in purpose, nothing changed since the latest version, or it kept changing

422.description: The draft has problems, each named in `errors`

post.summary: Freeze the draft as the next version. Agents that pin an older one see an update.

400.description: Not a WebSocket upgrade that offers vak.media.v1

403.description: The handshake comes from a page on another site

404.description: No such session for this operator, or it expired or was used

get.summary:
The session's media WebSocket. Offer the `vak.media.v1` subprotocol; the text and binary
frames are described in `contracts/media/`.

409.description: The agent is archived, or a run of it is already queued or running

503.description: The server has no models for test runs, or storage is unavailable

post.summary:
Queue a test run of the agent's current draft: every scenario is played by a simulated
caller and scored by its rubric, in the background. Poll the run for its progress.

200.description: The run

503.description: Test runs aren't set up, or storage is unavailable

get.summary:
The run: its status and progress, its verdict once finished, and every scenario's
transcript and rubric checks so far.

200.description: The cancelled run

503.description: Test runs aren't set up, or storage is unavailable

post.summary:
Cancel a queued or running run; what is left is skipped. Cancelling a cancelled run
changes nothing.

200.description: One histogram per stage

get.summary: The voice path's latency so far: one histogram per stage, since the server started.

200.description: The process is serving HTTP

get.summary: Liveness: answers while the process serves HTTP. Unauthenticated, checks no dependencies.
